ticks.note: `Idle` to `Busy` fires in both charts, so `Busy` is entered in this tick. `DuringCount`'s plain `during` action skips the entry tick: `n` stays 0. `ImmediateDuringCount`'s `immediate during` runs in it: `n` is 1 at once.
`Busy` was active when the tick began, so both during actions run: 1 in `DuringCount`, 2 in `ImmediateDuringCount`.
One more in each, every tick: the `immediate during` version stays one ahead.
